title: Carbon foam derived from co-carbonization of lignin and petroleum asphalt for high-efficiency solar evaporators
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8545-8557
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10093C, Paper

Jiawei Shang, Wangda Qu, Chen Liang, Linghong Yin, Ming Li, Jing Liu
A robust solar interfacial evaporator (CF2) developed by co-carbonizing lignin and petroleum asphalt is presented, offering a solution for high-value utilization of asphalt.
